scripts.prebuild: npm run test:boxoffice && node ../scripts/guard-offbrand-series.mjs --protect-list .cull-protect-list.json && node ../scripts/guard-offbrand-films.mjs && node scripts/build-series-links.mjs && node scripts/sync-public.mjs && node scripts/generate-image-variants.mjs && node scripts/build-search-index.mjs && node scripts/build-ask-index.mjs && node scripts/build-sitemaps.mjs
scripts.build: next build && npm run lint:aggregate && npm run postbuild:filecap
scripts.postbuild:filecap: find out -type f -name '*.avif' -delete; find out -name 'index.txt' -delete; C=$(find out -type f | wc -l); echo "filecap: out has $C files"; [ "$C" -lt 20000 ] || { echo 'ERROR: CF Pages 20k-file cap exceeded - reduce files (drop a format / upgrade plan)'; exit 1; }
